title: ERP / Accounting Export
description: Export financial data to JSON or CSV for import into your accounting or ERP system.
noData: No data found for the selected filters.

help.title: About ERP export
help.overview: ERP export builds downloadable datasets for accounting systems. Choose one or more datasets, optional project, and a date range. This page does not post to SAP or Abacus — it produces JSON (preview) or CSV (download) those systems can ingest.

sections.title: Datasets you can include
items: Sales — closed commercial sales in range.
Unit costs — owner-side spend on units.
BOQ items, cost commitments, progress claims, permits — construction/finance records when that module data exists for the company.

sections.title: On this page
items: Select datasets (at least one), optional project filter, date from/to, then Preview JSON or Export CSV.
Empty result means no source rows in range — widen dates or drop the project filter.
Preview tables are the same columns the CSV will contain.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Read-only extract. Re-running with the same filters produces a new file from current data.
It will not mark invoices exported or change payment status.
Unit costs here are owner expenses; rental payments are tenant months — do not mix them in the receiving ERP as the same account unless your accountant says so.

sections.title: Related records
items: Whatever you ticked: sales, commissions, payment plans, rental payments, unit costs, and optional construction collections.
